articles.title: Tensions Erupt After Woman Leaves Home to Live with Husband Akbar; Hindu Groups Vandalize Shop
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a tense incident in Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, Sonika Chauhan reportedly left her home to live with Akbar, with whom she claims to have been in a relationship for 9 years and married through court procedures three years ago.

body.html:
In a tense incident in Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, Sonika Chauhan reportedly left her home to live with Akbar, with whom she claims to have been in a relationship for 9 years and married through court procedures three years ago. The matter escalated when Hindu organizations, angered by the development, vandalized Akbar's shop in the presence of police officers. Items from the shop were thrown out and damaged during the attack.

Police later recovered Sonika and arrested Akbar on charges of disturbing the peace. However, the woman's statement has not yet been recorded in court.

In her statement to the media, Sonika clarified that she left with Akbar of her own free will and that the couple had been married for years. The situation reportedly worsened after her family recently discovered their relationship, leading to a domestic dispute.

Authorities are investigating the matter and maintaining security in the area to prevent further unrest.

articles.title: PM Modi Recalls Congress Leader’s Remark: “Politicians Must Learn to Say No, Bureaucrats to Say Yes”
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: PM Modi in Gandhinagar: “About 40 years ago, a Congress leader was asked how to fix the country's problems in two lines.

body.html:
PM Modi in Gandhinagar: “About 40 years ago, a Congress leader was asked how to fix the country's problems in two lines. His reply still resonates — politicians must learn to say ‘No’ and bureaucrats must learn to say ‘Yes.’ A politician never says no, and a bureaucrat never says yes.”

articles.title: Bahraich: Woman Arrested for Stealing Lakhs to Fulfill Boyfriend's Desires
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A bizarre love story took a criminal turn in Bahraich, Uttar Pradesh, when a young woman allegedly committed a major theft to meet her boyfriend’s demands.

body.html:
A bizarre love story took a criminal turn in Bahraich, Uttar Pradesh, when a young woman allegedly committed a major theft to meet her boyfriend’s demands. The accused, who worked as domestic help in a house in Qazipura locality, stole gold and silver jewellery along with Rs 40,000 in cash—amounting to a total theft of nearly Rs 6-7 lakh.

With the stolen money, she reportedly bought a bike for her boyfriend. Police have arrested the woman and recovered the cash, jewellery, and the bike. Additionally, a goldsmith who had purchased some of the stolen gold has also been taken into custody.

The case falls under the jurisdiction of Kotwali Nagar police station. Further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Bengaluru: Zepto Delivery Turns Violent, Customer Injured Over Address Mix-Up
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A Zepto delivery in Bengaluru's Basaveshwaranagar took a violent turn on May 21 when a delivery executive allegedly assaulted a customer over a minor address mismatch. The incident, captured on CCTV, has triggered outrage and a police investigation.

body.html:
A Zepto delivery in Bengaluru's Basaveshwaranagar took a violent turn on May 21 when a delivery executive allegedly assaulted a customer over a minor address mismatch. The incident, captured on CCTV, has triggered outrage and a police investigation.

According to reports, Vishnuvardhan, a delivery agent for Zepto, engaged in a heated argument with the sister-in-law of Shashank, the customer. The altercation escalated when Shashank intervened, prompting the delivery agent to allegedly abuse and physically attack him. The assault resulted in serious injuries near Shashank’s eye, causing partial vision loss. Doctors have now recommended surgery.

A case has been registered under BNS sections 115(2), 126(2), 351(2), and 352 at the Basaveshwaranagar Police Station. Authorities have also issued a notice to Zepto, and efforts are underway to trace the absconding delivery agent.

Zepto has since responded via Instagram, apologising and asking for order details to investigate the incident swiftly. “Professional conduct is essential to us... Could you DM us your order details so we can look into it at Zepto speed?” the company wrote.

This incident comes at a time when Zepto is already facing legal scrutiny. On April 24, the Delhi High Court issued notices to Zepto, Swiggy, and the IT Ministry following a petition by NGO Mission Accessibility, alleging that their apps are inaccessible to visually impaired users, in violation of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.

articles.title: Ghaziabad Tragedy: ACP Office Roof Collapses During Storm, Kills Sub-Inspector Veerendra Mishra
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 58-year-old sub-inspector of the Uttar Pradesh Police lost his life when the roof of the ACP office in Ankur Vihar, Ghaziabad, collapsed during a fierce storm around midnight on Saturday.

body.html:
A 58-year-old sub-inspector of the Uttar Pradesh Police lost his life when the roof of the ACP office in Ankur Vihar, Ghaziabad, collapsed during a fierce storm around midnight on Saturday. The deceased, identified as SI Veerendra Mishra, had stayed late to finish pending work and was found dead under the debris around 2am.

According to DCP (Rural) Surendra Nath Tiwari, Mishra was likely asleep in a chair when the incident occurred. When police teams arrived and found the office locked from inside, they forced open the door and discovered the officer buried beneath the rubble. He was rushed to the hospital but declared dead on arrival.

The building, which had undergone renovations just two years ago, is now under scrutiny for construction lapses. Late Sunday night, authorities arrested two contractors involved in the renovation work — Ballu Chaudhary from Delhi and Ashish Kumar from Modinagar — amid concerns over structural integrity and possible negligence.

Veerendra Mishra had served the UP Police for over three decades. His sudden death has not only shaken the force but also raised serious questions about infrastructure safety in government buildings.

articles.title: Uttar Pradesh: Chain Collision in Pilibhit District Involving Magic Vehicle, Canter, and Bike
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A serious road accident occurred in Pilibhit district of Uttar Pradesh due to sudden braking by a Magic vehicle in the middle of the road. The unexpected halt led to a chain collision involving a wood-laden canter and a motorcycle.

body.html:
A serious road accident occurred in Pilibhit district of Uttar Pradesh due to sudden braking by a Magic vehicle in the middle of the road. The unexpected halt led to a chain collision involving a wood-laden canter and a motorcycle.

According to eyewitnesses, the Magic vehicle abruptly stopped without warning. The canter coming from behind was unable to apply emergency brakes in time and rammed into it. The impact pushed the Magic vehicle across to the opposite side of the road, where a motorcycle collided with it.

Initial reports suggest that the fault lies with the Magic vehicle for the sudden stop. Further investigation is underway to assess damages and any injuries.
